# SunburstChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSunburstChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasSunburstChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasSunburstChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasSunburstChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Parts of a whole, nested: sunburst, treemap, layered proportional areas

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSunburstChart> CreateSunburstChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSunburstChart> CreateSunburstChartFromGroups( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::pair<std::string, double>>>>& groupedData);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSunburstChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetValueFormatter()` | `void SetValueFormatter(std::function<std::string(double)> f)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetPercentageFormatter()` | `void SetPercentageFormatter(std::function<std::string(double pct)> f)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetSunburstTooltipFormatter()` | `void SetSunburstTooltipFormatter(std::function<std::string(const SunburstNode&)> f)` | Takes a callback. |
| `onSegmentClick` | `std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<SunburstNode>&, int)> onSegmentClick` | Callbacks: node + depth (1 = innermost visible ring) |
| `onSegmentHover` | `std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<SunburstNode>&, int)> onSegmentHover` | _Segment hover_ |
| `onDrillChange` | `std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<SunburstNode>&)> onDrillChange` | _Drill change_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `SunburstNode`

A node in the sunburst hierarchy. Leaf nodes carry a value; the weight of a branch node is the sum of its children (its own `value` is ignored once children are added, matching the standard sunburst/partition convention).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `value` | `double value = 0.0` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Transparent = derive automatically |
| `children` | `std::vector<std::shared_ptr<SunburstNode>> children` |  |
| `parent` | `std::weak_ptr<SunburstNode> parent` |  |

Methods: `AddChild`, `FindChild`, `IsLeaf`, `AggregatedValue`, `SubtreeDepth`

### enum `SunburstLabelOrientation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Auto` | Radial when it fits better, horizontal otherwise |
| `Horizontal` | Always horizontal |
| `Radial` | Text runs along the radius, flipped on the left side |

### enum `SunburstShadeMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoShade` | Children inherit the branch color unchanged |
| `LightenByDepth` | Each deeper ring is progressively lighter |
| `DarkenByDepth` | Each deeper ring is progressively darker |
